title: International Rowdy
desc: Love invents a lethal drug and gives it to terrorist outfits, who use it to kill Indian officials in Kuala Lumpur. When RAW officers find a love emblem tattoo on his neck, they start investigating.

title: Real Tevar
desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

title: Kick
desc: Devi, a man who cannot stay put as he is addicted to going on new adventures, breaks up with his girlfriend, Shaina, who is a Warsaw-based psychiatrist, just to pursue his daredevil ambitions.

title: Baby John
desc: An indomitable policeman goes to greater lengths and leads a double life in order to protect his daughter from the criminal underworld.

title: C.D: Criminal or Devil
desc: Sidhu crosses paths with a mysterious girl named Raksha. As she wildly oscillates between acting like a criminal and a literal devil, Sidhu is left to uncover her true nature.

title: Ek Paheli Maya
desc: Apsara, a single mother, struggles to make a living by working in advertisements. However, her life turns into a mess when a ghost starts haunting her and causes the death of people known to her.

title: Gadha Yudha
desc: Bheema and his team try to figure out the science behind black magic. Later, they learn about Mruthyu, a demon who is hiding on an island and is murdering people with his powers.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Aaj Ka Raavanraj
desc: Seenu's love for a faction leader's daughter leads to him battling her ruthless father. Later, he weaves a daring plan to end their blood feud by winning over the rival faction.
